topics.title: Drug Use and Confessions - LSD & Rob Lowe
topics.summary: The conversation centers around a man’s recounting of his experiences with drugs, primarily LSD, involving multiple women including an acquaintance and eventually Rob Lowe. He describes taking ludes to sleep through events, falling into unwanted sexual encounters, and the widespread use of these drugs among college students in the 1970s, often accompanied by humorous tangents about commercial endorsements.

topics.title: Rob Discusses Relationships and Car Cash
topics.summary: During an interview, Rob discusses his difficulty forming relationships with colleagues referencing past experiences working with ‘the Brat Pack’ and a fondness for spending evenings with Rob Lowe. He recounts casual interactions like going out after work or attending the Hamptons filming of 'Masquerade,' detailing awkward encounters involving potential romantic interests and a fortune cookie prediction about attracting attention.

topics.title: Car Cash Call & Helmsley Rant
topics.summary: A caller discusses a new car cash service (212 or 516 CAR CASH) and his family's wealth before launching into an outrageous series of demands, impersonations of Maury Povitz and Leona Helmsley, and bizarre discussions about aerobics instructors and Rob Lowe.

topics.title: Late Night Hotel Room Confessions
topics.summary: Howard interviews Justin about a series of encounters involving an aerobics instructor, a hairdresser and a model who spent the night in Rob Lowe’s hotel room. The conversation quickly devolves into speculation regarding details—including how the girls ended up there, their ages, and specific activities—with multiple interruptions from Robin and Howard.

topics.title: Bon Jovi Phone Mishap - Family Fallout
topics.summary: Howard Stern takes a call from Justin Bon Jovi who mistakenly connects, revealing his sister is upset he wasn’t informed of his Letterman appearance and that he's being ‘entitled.’ The conversation escalates with Jon demanding to speak directly to John, further fueled by the family’s disapproval.

topics.title: Awkward Sex Tape Confessions
topics.summary: A phone conversation reveals uncomfortable confessions about a sex tape involving Rob Lowe and various individuals, including awkward details of sexual encounters with varying degrees of explicitness. Topics range from the video itself to fantasies and personal experiences, touching on themes of insecurity and youthful indiscretion.
